thread:
tess: Promo to staging for ai-ingress v3.0.0 stalled. deploy-bot reports helm install failed: admission webhook "authz.redwood.ai" denied request creating CRD 'authorizationpolicies'. Hook blocked resource creation and the release is in FAILED state. Anyone know what changed in the authz subchart?

deploy-bot: promote-blocked: hook-failure admission-webhook denied creating authorizationpolicy; release_status=FAILED; action=hold. logs: kubectl -n staging logs pod/authz-webhook-9b7c -c webhook

ivan: i noticed authz subchart was bumped to 1.5.0 which migrated AuthorizationPolicy CRD group from authz.redwood.ai/v1beta1 -> authz.redwood.ai/v1. The webhook now validates an additional field 'bindMode' and rejects old manifests.

rachel: did our templated manifests include bindMode? no, older templates omit it and server-side defaults are not accepted by the webhook. Looks like the subchart expects consumers to pass bindMode explicitly.

tess: options: 1) roll back main chart to v2.9.x (pin) and abort promo, 2) hotpatch staging release by templating bindMode into authz manifests and re-run canary (fast), 3) disable the admission webhook temporarily (risky), 4) patch the authz subchart to accept missing bindMode (PR + merge, ~30-45m).

ivan: we should avoid disabling the webhook. For prod we want strict validation. Hotpatching the canary templates to include bindMode for staging is reasonable to unblock, but we must ensure the upstream chart gets fixed before any prod promo.

rachel: i'll open a minimal hotpatch PR to inject bindMode: "strict" into the authz template when chart version >= 1.5.0 and create a follow-up PR to add schema validation tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/789 (hotpatch for staging). ETA ~15m.

ops-bot: tagging incident INC-2026-219 for webhook schema change; assigning to platform infra.

tess: can we re-run the canary once PR merged? also should we pin staging during the hotpatch landing to avoid an automated re-promote racing in?

deploy-bot: suggested_action=temporary_hotpatch_and_hold_unpinned, reason="inject bindMode into authz manifests for staging canary; follow-up fix required before prod", user=tess, timestamp=2834512352

ivan: i'll apply a temporary patch to the running release via kubectl -n staging patch -f authz-template-patch.yaml and restart the hook pods. will monitor.

rachel: PR created and linked to release notes. also added a unit test that ensures AuthorizationPolicy templates include bindMode.

ivan: applied patch; webhook logs now show resources accepted and helm chart progressed to DEPLOYED. canary ready.

tess: leaving a release-note fragment: "Staging canary initially blocked by admission webhook after authz subchart bumped to 1.5.0 introducing required 'bindMode' field. Temporary hotpatch applied to canary templates; charts PR#789 landed to add bindMode and schema test. No prod impact. Follow-up: enforce subchart compatibility check in promote pipeline."

ops-bot: recorded mitigation: temporary_patch_by=ivan, patch_ref=PR#789, followup_owner=rachel, followup_deadline=+48h

tess: ok marking promo resumed and will not promote to prod until subchart compatibility gate added. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
